distanceModel.formulaWaterPolicy: dotted water is hydration; parenthesized/bracketed water is structural water
distanceModel.coordinateCaveat: Force-directed coordinates are normalized layout positions; edge distances and component values remain authoritative.

mapParameters.normalization: centered and scaled to approximately [-0.95, 0.95] on each axis

relationshipCategories.polymorph: Same parsed chemistry and formula water; differentiated by structure only.
relationshipCategories.hydration_variant: Same framework chemistry; differs in dotted water of hydration.
relationshipCategories.structural_water_variant: Same framework chemistry; differs in parenthesized or bracketed structural water.
relationshipCategories.redox_variant: Same cation elements but a changed oxidation-state distribution.
relationshipCategories.cation_analogue: Same anion framework with cation substitution; valence evidence may be incomplete.
relationshipCategories.anion_group_analogue: Same cations and residual anions with substituted oxyanion groups.
relationshipCategories.extra_anion_analogue: Same cation and oxyanion framework with residual-anion substitution.
relationshipCategories.coupled_substitution: Coordinated cation and residual-anion substitutions in one anion framework.
relationshipCategories.compositional_subset: One parsed formula feature set is a strict subset of the other.
relationshipCategories.same_structural_group: Different composition components within the same named structural group.
relationshipCategories.multiple_substitutions: More than one compositional component differs materially.
relationshipCategories.distant_analogue: No more specific rule applies at the selected neighbourhood scale.
relationshipCategories.approximate_landmark_neighbour: Nearest neighbour found by an exploratory landmark-signature search; relationship class is pending exact pairwise recomputation.

coordinateSystem: normalized 3D force-directed layout of the exact additive k-nearest-neighbour graph; edge distances remain authoritative
